scope: All scoped Python filesystem reader/path signatures and call occurrences in gpuwrf plus runtime Python assets; new sites require binding review. No AOT key behavior changes.

bindings.wrf_run: runtime_data_identity.WRF_RUN_PATTERNS: land/soil/vegetation/urban; CAM/RRTM/RRTMG; cloud/aerosol/greenhouse-gas data and fallbacks
bindings.wrf_source: WRF_SOURCE_TABLES + actual RRTMG extractor source and DATA candidate locations
bindings.package_data: all non-Python package data, including lake/urban/cloud/gas tables and native initializer source/data; Python code separately bound by nested_identity.source_sha256
bindings.assets: all common bundle assets and large remote assets selected by assets.tables_for_schemes (actual loader mapping); existing bytes freshly hashed; absent remote assets bound by enforced SHA256 pin
bindings.case_and_restart: native case input content hashes, namelist/carry identities and authenticated checkpoint/history payloads
bindings.derived_or_offline: cache serialization, generated helper scratch, profiling/validation/CLI reports and offline readers are inventoried, not scientific table inputs
bindings.host_override_protocol: Offline io.field_override SPEC parsing, referenced value/mask files, input wrfinput/wrflowinp validation and staging/report IO. Parsed SPEC is recorded in OVERRIDE_PROTOCOL.json; external values/masks and source/output files carry content hashes there. These are host-tool inputs/outputs, not model runtime tables.
bindings.host_precompile_protocol: Offline runtime.precompile_cli variant/namelist, package/asset table, case-input, native/meta/cache and request/result/index/report IO. Fresh SHA256 binds variant namelists, source/package/table and case bytes; request/index context binds versions, environment and GPU target. Cache reuse freshly rehashes every recorded native/meta/cache entry and validates native SHA against metadata. Temporary views/logs/receipts are derived host-tool IO, not scientific table loaders. Official-lock inode/device validation is live FD ownership only, never a persisted receipt identity.
bindings.source_import_cache_protocol: Derived runtime.aot_cheap_key source-import AST cache: each lookup hashes current source BYTES; versioned payload binds source_sha256 and import-payload SHA256. Corrupt/partial/schema/content mismatches or IO errors recompute from current source; atomic temporary writes accelerate parsing only. Current source and dependency closure remain bound; no persisted device/inode/mtime key.
bindings.runtime_parameter_operands: Host JSON schema/domain selection and finite REAL32 admission in runtime_parameters.load_parameters/bind_domain_parameters. Consumed names/shapes/dtypes/values are authenticated by restart_parameter_digests (controls_digest) in single-domain io.restart and per-domain nested_identity. Ordinary resume refuses changed values; declared checkpoint branching separately binds permitted edits. Raw JSON whitespace and unused-domain entries do not change the consumed operands. AOT keys intentionally bind names/shapes/dtypes, not tunable values; no scientific table loader is added.
bindings.thompson_cloud_number_asset: Thompson Nt_c host_tables reads the common bundled data/fixtures/thompson-ntc-v1.npz only via asset_path/ensure_asset. assets_manifest.json pins SHA256+bytes; runtime_data_identity hashes all bundle assets independently of scheme selection. Host NumPy caching does not bypass content binding.
bindings.host_atmosphere_cycle_protocol: Host-only cycling source/fresh wrfinput, wrfout/wrfrst and boundary reads plus private staging/publication IO. Source and fresh bytes are freshly SHA256-hashed before transfer and rechecked before atomic publication. GPUWRF_LAND_CYCLE and GPUWRF_ATMOSPHERE_CYCLE embed source/input hashes, exact per-field stored content/mask hashes, geometry/time/species and consistency receipts; native source/copied/derived arrays have individual hashes. Scientific runtime tables retain existing package/WRF/asset binding; this category creates no table exemption.
bindings.cycling_wrf_source_reference: start_em.F:767,878,1475,2259-2544 is a documentation/reference string in start_domain_cycling, not a filesystem read. Its Python implementation is bound by nested_identity.source_sha256; original-source oracle evidence remains independent.
bindings.mynn_budget_code_projection: Budget-only AST statement/import literals, not external data readers. Generated equations and native/imported modules are Python source bound by nested_identity.source_sha256; exact projected function text SHA256 is also reported in MYNN PRODUCTION_SOURCE_SHA256. No scientific data file or new runtime table is read.
bindings.host_surface_control_preflight: Host-only W2 release-refusal preflight reads a surface-control NPZ with allow_pickle=False and inspects only manifest schema/names before binding any batch member. It does not consume value arrays or add scientific tables. Subsequent load_controls authenticates each consumed domain mapping with controls_digest; restart_controls_digest/nested identity bind effective values, and the AOT key binds their names/shapes/dtypes rather than tunable values. This category creates no data/table exemption.
